main.description: Trigger an incremental HubSpot CRM sync for a single object type. Reads vertex_hubspot_sync_cursor for the last modified watermark, calls /crm/v3/objects/{objectType}/search with filter `hs_lastmodifieddate > cursor`, paginates 100 per page (HubSpot v3 max), upserts each record to vertex_hubspot_{objectType} via Hyperdrive direct write (ADR-0036), and advances the cursor. Idempotent — safe to retry. Backfill: pass since='1970-01-01' to ignore the cursor.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp lower bound for hs_lastmodifieddate. Overrides the persisted cursor when set.

portalId.description: HubSpot portal id for multi-tenant. Defaults to env HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID.

completed.description: True when the API returned no more pages.
